reader.requirement: At --std 85, LINES AT TOP integer-3 or the value of data-name-3 (an elementary unsigned integer item) gives the number of lines in the top margin of each logical page, zero allowed, written on the medium before the page body; a data-name's value is taken at OPEN OUTPUT for the first page and at each ADVANCING PAGE or page overflow for the next page (GR7), and the counter counts only body lines.

reader.notes: The top margin is written as blank lines on the medium at OPEN OUTPUT and at each new logical page, and a data-name-3 is re-read at the page change as GR7 b requires; zero, as literal and as data-name value, gives no margin. Variable-length records and failed-open paths do not bear on this rule (a LINAGE file is output-only for the margin), so classes a and the failed-open half of e were not probed.

refuter.evidence: Attacked GR4 through GR7b's timing, which the reader's lt01 left open for the END-OF-PAGE path: lteop.cob at --std 85 (LINAGE 2 LINES TOP TOPN OF CTL, TOPN 1 at OPEN; the EOP imperative MOVEs 4 to TOPN; later overflow without EOP): medium lines 1 blank, 2 A1, 3 A2, 4 blank, 5 A3, 6 A4, 7-10 blank, 11 A5 and 'EOP1 LC 1', i.e. page 2 took the value at the overflow (1), not the one the imperative set after repositioning (§1985:VII.4.7.4 GR18), and page 3 took 4; a qualified data-name-3 works. PB: TOPB 2 at OPEN then 0, first WRITE BEFORE ADVANCING PAGE: lines 1-2 margin, 3 B1, 4 blank, 5 B2 (page 2 margin 0). ltfs.cob data-name-3 in another file's FILE SECTION record (1985 SR1 does not restrict the section): accepted, 2 at OPEN gives lines 1-2 blank, A1 line 3, 0 at the overflow gives A2 on line 4. ltext.cob OPEN EXTEND of a LINAGE file refused COBOL2372 (§1985:VII.4.3.3 SR3), so no unspecified margin path exists. LINAGE-COUNTER reads 1 after the reposition. Note the compiler places the first WRITE AFTER ADVANCING 1 on body line 2 (LINAGE-COUNTER set to 1 at OPEN, then advanced), consistent with GR9c/d; that is a WRITE/LINAGE-COUNTER matter, not GR4's margin size. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR4  (║3.7.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR4'; 'OK  §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR7b  (║3.7.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR7b'; 'OK  §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR18  (4.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR18'; 'OK  §1985:VII.4.3.3 SR3  (4.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3'.
